name: rq
description: Go to definition, backed by the rq CLI.

rq.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `rq` binary. The default finds it on `PATH`; set an absolute path if VS Code's `PATH` doesn't include it (e.g. `/opt/homebrew/bin/rq`).

rq.languages.markdownDescription: Languages rq answers Go to Definition for (`typescript`/`javascript` include `.tsx`/`.jsx`). With `rq.mode` set to `fallback`, rq only answers where the language's own server finds nothing, so it's safe to leave on alongside rust-analyzer, gopls, Pylance or TypeScript. An empty list turns rq off for every language, Cmd/Ctrl-T included (to leave only Cmd/Ctrl-T to the servers, use `rq.workspaceSymbols: off`).

enumDescriptions: Answer only when no other definition provider (a language server) finds anything — no duplicate results.
Always answer, alongside any language server. Expect duplicates and a peek list where both answer.
rq.mode.markdownDescription: When rq answers Go to Definition.

enumDescriptions: Add only symbols no language server already returned (matched by file and line, or name within the file).
Leave Go to Symbol in Workspace (Cmd/Ctrl-T) to the language servers.
Always add rq's ranked symbols, duplicates included.
rq.workspaceSymbols.markdownDescription: How rq contributes to Go to Symbol in Workspace (Cmd/Ctrl-T).
